00001| // The planner's result types and the argument builders every route shares
00002| // (rust/src/agentic_coding/planner.rs `AgenticPlan`, `PlannedToolCall`,
00003| // `plan_one`, `write_arguments`, `fetch_arguments`).
00004| //
00005| // An `AgenticPlan` is `{kind: 'tool_calls', calls: [{tool, arguments}]}` or
00006| // `{kind: 'final', answer}`; `arguments` is the JSON text Rust's
00007| // `serde_json::Value::to_string` prints (see `jsonText`).
00008| 
00009| /** Mirrors `enum AgenticPlan` in rust/src/agentic_coding/planner.rs (`ToolCalls`). @param {Array<{tool: string, arguments: string}>} calls */
00010| export function toolCalls(calls) {
00011|   return { kind: 'tool_calls', calls };
00012| }
00013| 
00014| /** `AgenticPlan::Final`. @param {string} answer */
00015| export function finalAnswer(answer) {
00016|   return { kind: 'final', answer };
00017| }
00018| 
00019| /** Internal outcome semantics; public final answers project to their text. */
00020| export const FinalDisposition = Object.freeze({
00021|   Finding: 'finding', Artifact: 'artifact', Clarification: 'clarification',
00022|   Gap: 'gap', Failure: 'failure', Unknown: 'unknown',
00023| });
00024| 
00025| /** Construct a final result at the route that knows its disposition and origin. */
00026| export function resolvedFinalAnswer(answer, disposition, origin) {
00027|   return { ...finalAnswer(answer), result: { text: answer, disposition, origin } };
00028| }
00029| 
00030| /** Legacy routes have no evidence certificate and remain unknown. */
00031| export function finalResult(plan) {
00032|   return plan?.kind !== 'final' ? null : plan.result
00033|     ?? { text: plan.answer, disposition: FinalDisposition.Unknown, origin: null };
00034| }
00035| 
00036| /** Only a route-certified finding can become an investigation's file content. */
00037| export function canDeliverFinal(plan) {
00038|   const result = finalResult(plan);
00039|   return result?.disposition === FinalDisposition.Finding
00040|     && typeof result.origin === 'string' && result.origin.length > 0;
00041| }
00042| 
00043| /** Preserve the existing public tool-call/final-answer protocol. */
00044| export function projectPlan(plan) {
00045|   return plan?.kind === 'final' ? finalAnswer(plan.answer) : plan;
00046| }
00047| 
00048| /** Mirrors `struct PlannedToolCall` in rust/src/agentic_coding/planner.rs. @param {string} tool @param {string} args */
00049| export function plannedCall(tool, args) {
00050|   return { tool, arguments: args };
00051| }
00052| 
00053| /** Whether `plan` is `AgenticPlan::ToolCalls`: Rust built-in `matches!`. */
00054| export function isToolCalls(plan) {
00055|   return plan?.kind === 'tool_calls';
00056| }
00057| 
00058| /** Whether `plan` is `AgenticPlan::Final`: Rust built-in `matches!`. */
00059| export function isFinal(plan) {
00060|   return plan?.kind === 'final';
00061| }
00062| 
00063| /**
00064|  * `serde_json::Value::to_string` of a JSON object built with `json!`.
00065|  *
00066|  * serde_json without `preserve_order` stores objects in a `BTreeMap`, so its
00067|  * text lists keys sorted by byte order at every depth; this prints the same.
00068|  * @param {unknown} value
00069|  * @returns {string}
00070|  */
00071| export function jsonText(value) {
00072|   return JSON.stringify(sortKeys(value));
00073| }
00074| 
00075| function sortKeys(value) {
00076|   if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(sortKeys);
00077|   if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
00078|     const out = {};
00079|     for (const key of Object.keys(value).sort(byteOrder)) out[key] = sortKeys(value[key]);
00080|     return out;
00081|   }
00082|   return value;
00083| }
00084| 
00085| function byteOrder(left, right) {
00086|   const a = Array.from(left, (character) => character.codePointAt(0));
00087|   const b = Array.from(right, (character) => character.codePointAt(0));
00088|   for (let index = 0; index < Math.min(a.length, b.length); index += 1) {
00089|     if (a[index] !== b[index]) return a[index] - b[index];
00090|   }
00091|   return a.length - b.length;
00092| }
00093| 
00094| /** `plan_one`: a single planned call. @param {string} tool @param {string} args */
00095| export function planOne(tool, args) {
00096|   return toolCalls([plannedCall(tool, args)]);
00097| }
00098| 
00099| /** `write_arguments`. @param {string} path @param {string} content */
00100| export function writeArguments(path, content) {
00101|   return jsonText({ path, filePath: path, file_path: path, content });
00102| }
00103| 
00104| /** `fetch_arguments`. @param {string} url */
00105| export function fetchArguments(url) {
00106|   return jsonText({ url, format: 'text' });
00107| }
